list.definition:
SELECT DisplayName FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V Host CPU' AND p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE())
  UNION ALL SELECT '(no hosts found)' WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
    JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
    JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
    WHERE r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V Host CPU' AND p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE()))
) x ORDER BY DisplayName

title: Hyper-V Performance - Virtual Machines

panels.description: Virtual machines on the selected hosts with performance data in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT i.InstanceName AS inst, r.CounterName AS ctr, p.SampleValue AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880 AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName IN ('Community Hyper-V VM CPU', 'Community Hyper-V VM Memory', 'Community Hyper-V VM Storage')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName) > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.InstanceName, r.CounterName, p.AverageValue
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName IN ('Community Hyper-V VM CPU', 'Community Hyper-V VM Memory', 'Community Hyper-V VM Storage')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName) > 0
),
a AS (
  SELECT inst, ctr, AVG(v) AS av, MAX(v) AS mx FROM s
  GROUP BY inst, ctr
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ctr = 'Total Run Time % (average of virtual processors)' THEN inst END) AS "VMs reporting",
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Total Run Time % (average of virtual processors)' THEN av END), 1) AS "Average VM CPU %",
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Total Run Time % (average of virtual processors)' THEN mx END), 1) AS "Busiest VM CPU %",
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Assigned Memory MB' THEN av END), 0) AS "Memory assigned MB",
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ctr IN ('Read IOPS', 'Write IOPS') THEN av END), 1) AS "Disk IOPS"
FROM a

panels.title: Disk operations

panels.description: One row per VM on the selected hosts for the time range. Click a VM name to show only that VM in the graphs below (the Virtual machine drop-down at the top does the same, and takes several). CPU is a percentage of the CPU the VM has been given. CPU max is the highest 5-minute (or hourly) average, not an instantaneous peak. Disk latency is in the counter's own unit, which is not independently verified. Memory demand is empty for VMs without Dynamic Memory or when the installed management pack does not collect it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS host, i.InstanceName AS inst, r.CounterName AS ctr, p.SampleValue AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880 AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName IN ('Community Hyper-V VM CPU', 'Community Hyper-V VM Memory', 'Community Hyper-V VM Storage', 'Community Hyper-V VM Network')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName) > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName, r.CounterName, p.AverageValue
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName IN ('Community Hyper-V VM CPU', 'Community Hyper-V VM Memory', 'Community Hyper-V VM Storage', 'Community Hyper-V VM Network')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName) > 0
),
a AS (
  SELECT host, LEFT(inst, CHARINDEX(' (', inst + ' (') - 1) AS vm, SUBSTRING(inst, CHARINDEX(' (', inst) + 2, 36) AS guid, inst, ctr, AVG(v) AS av, MAX(v) AS mx
  FROM s
  GROUP BY host, LEFT(inst, CHARINDEX(' (', inst + ' (') - 1), SUBSTRING(inst, CHARINDEX(' (', inst) + 2, 36), inst, ctr
),
f AS (
  SELECT host, vm, guid,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Total Run Time % (average of virtual processors)' THEN av END) AS cpu_avg,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Total Run Time % (average of virtual processors)' THEN mx END) AS cpu_max,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Total Run Time % (busiest virtual processor)' THEN mx END) AS vp_max,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Assigned Memory MB' THEN av END) AS mem_assigned,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Memory Demand % of Assigned' THEN av END) AS mem_demand_pct,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Read IOPS' THEN av END) AS r_iops,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Write IOPS' THEN av END) AS w_iops,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ctr IN ('Read Throughput Bytes per sec', 'Write Throughput Bytes per sec') THEN av END) AS thr,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr LIKE 'Latency%' THEN mx END) AS lat_max,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Queue Length' THEN mx END) AS q_max,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ctr IN ('Packets Received per sec', 'Packets Sent per sec') THEN av END) AS pps,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ctr IN ('Dropped Packets Incoming per sec', 'Dropped Packets Outgoing per sec') THEN av END) AS drops
  FROM a GROUP BY host, vm, guid
),
c AS (
  SELECT host, vm, guid,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Virtual Processor Count' THEN v END) AS vcpu,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Dynamic Memory Enabled' THEN v END) AS dyn,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ctr = 'Startup Memory MB' THEN v END) AS startup
  FROM (
    SELECT h.DisplayName AS host, LEFT(i.InstanceName, CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName + ' (') - 1) AS vm, SUBSTRING(i.InstanceName, CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName) + 2, 36) AS guid,
           r.CounterName AS ctr, p.AverageValue AS v,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName, r.CounterName ORDER BY p.DateTime DESC) AS rn
    FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
    JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
    JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
    JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
    JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
    WHERE r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V VM Configuration' AND p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE())
      AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName) > 0
  ) q WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY host, vm, guid
)
SELECT f.vm AS "Virtual machine", f.host AS Host, c.vcpu AS vCPUs,
       CASE WHEN c.dyn IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN c.dyn >= 0.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Dyn. memory",
       ROUND(f.cpu_avg, 1) AS "CPU avg %", ROUND(f.cpu_max, 1) AS "CPU max %", ROUND(f.vp_max, 1) AS "vCPU max %",
       ROUND(f.mem_assigned, 0) AS "Mem MB", ROUND(f.mem_demand_pct, 1) AS "Mem demand %",
       ROUND(f.r_iops, 1) AS "Read IOPS", ROUND(f.w_iops, 1) AS "Write IOPS", ROUND(f.thr / 1048576.0, 3) AS "Disk MB/s",
       ROUND(f.lat_max, 2) AS "Disk latency", ROUND(f.q_max, 1) AS "Queue",
       ROUND(f.pps, 1) AS "Pkts/s", ROUND(f.drops, 2) AS "Drops/s"
FROM f LEFT JOIN c ON c.host = f.host AND c.guid = f.guid
ORDER BY f.cpu_avg DESC, f.vm

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time, LEFT(i.InstanceName, CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName + ' (') - 1) + CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(' :: ', i.InstanceName) > 0 THEN ' :: ' + SUBSTRING(i.InstanceName, CHARINDEX(' :: ', i.InstanceName) + 4, 200) ELSE '' END AS metric, AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V VM CPU' AND r.CounterName IN ('Total Run Time % (average of virtual processors)')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName) > 0 AND LEFT(i.InstanceName, CHARINDEX(' (', i.InstanceName + ' (') - 1) IN (${hvvm:singlequote})
